+class Step5SparseAttention:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        owner: Step5Attention,
+        sparse_config: Step5SparseConfig,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.owner = owner
+        self.sparse_config = sparse_config
+        self.sparse_rotary_emb = self._build_sparse_rotary_emb()
+        self._indexer_native_rope = not self.sparse_rotary_emb.enabled()
+        owner.add_module("sparse_indexer_rotary_emb", self.sparse_rotary_emb)
+        if not (
+            owner.params_dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and int(sparse_config.proxy_dim) == 256
+            and int(sparse_config.sparse_indexer_num_k_heads) == 1
+            and self.sparse_rotary_emb.is_neox_style
+            and self.sparse_rotary_emb.rotary_dim > 0
+            and not self.sparse_rotary_emb.use_flashinfer
+        ):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Step5 DSA requires BF16 params, proxy_dim=256, one sparse "
+                "indexer K head and a non-FlashInfer NeoX indexer RoPE."
+            )
+        self.fuse_qkv_preparation = owner.head_dim == 192
+
+    def prepare_qkv(
+        self,
+        positions,
+        hidden_states,
+        qkv,
+        qkzg,
+        slots,
+        key_cache,
+        value_cache,
+        decode_slots,
+    ):
+        from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.qkv_indexer_norm_rope import (
+            qkv_indexer_norm_rope,
+        )
+
+        owner = self.owner
+        index_q, index_k, index_z, gate = owner.qkv_indexer_proj.split_indexer(qkzg)
+        weights, _ = owner.sparse_indexer_w(hidden_states)
+        cache = (
+            typing.cast(Any, owner.attn.impl).summary_cache
+            if decode_slots is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        index_q, index_k, weights, q, k, v = qkv_indexer_norm_rope(
+            index_q,
+            index_k,
+            weights,
+            owner.sparse_indexer_q_norm.weight,
+            owner.sparse_indexer_k_norm.weight,
+            owner.sparse_indexer_k_norm.bias,
+            self.sparse_rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            positions.reshape(-1),
+            owner.sparse_indexer_q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            owner.zero_centered,
+            native_rope=self._indexer_native_rope,
+            main_inputs=(
+                qkv,
+                owner.q_norm.weight,
+                owner.k_norm.weight,
+                owner.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+                slots,
+                key_cache,
+                value_cache,
+                owner.num_heads,
+                owner.num_kv_heads,
+                owner.rotary_dim if owner.use_rope else 0,
+                owner.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+                float(owner.zero_centered),
+                owner.attn._k_scale,
+                owner.attn._v_scale,
+            ),
+            decode_cache=cache,
+            decode_z=index_z if cache is not None else None,
+            decode_slots=decode_slots,
+        )
+        return (q, k, v), (
+            index_q,
+            index_k,
+            weights,
+            index_z.view(-1, 1, 256),
+            gate,
+            cache is not None,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        qkzg: torch.Tensor,
+        kv_cache_dummy_dep: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        decode_slots: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        prepared_indexer=None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        if prepared_indexer is None:
+            prepared_indexer = self._project_sparse_indexer(
+                positions, hidden_states, qkzg, decode_slots=decode_slots
+            )
+        (
+            dsa_proxy_query,
+            dsa_proxy_key,
+            dsa_proxy_weights,
+            dsa_proxy_z,
+            extra_dims,
+            summary_updated,
+        ) = prepared_indexer
+        attn_output = self._forward_dsa_attention(
+            query,
+            key,
+            value,
+            dsa_proxy_query=dsa_proxy_query,
+            dsa_proxy_key=dsa_proxy_key,
+            dsa_proxy_weights=dsa_proxy_weights,
+            dsa_proxy_z=dsa_proxy_z,
+            kv_cache_dummy_dep=kv_cache_dummy_dep,
+            summary_updated=summary_updated,
+            defer_inactive_clear=(
+                decode_slots is not None and self.owner.use_head_wise_attn_gate
+            ),
+            # The attention applies the headwise gate while writing its output.
+            gate=extra_dims if self.owner.use_head_wise_attn_gate else None,
+        )
+        return attn_output, extra_dims
+
+    def _forward_dsa_attention(
+        self,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        dsa_proxy_query: torch.Tensor,
+        dsa_proxy_key: torch.Tensor,
+        dsa_proxy_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        dsa_proxy_z: torch.Tensor,
+        kv_cache_dummy_dep: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        summary_updated: bool = False,
+        defer_inactive_clear: bool = False,
+        gate: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        attn = self.owner.attn
+        hidden_size = attn.num_heads * attn.head_size_v
+        output = torch.empty(
+            (query.shape[0], hidden_size),
+            dtype=query.dtype,
+            device=query.device,
+        )
+
+        query = query.view(-1, attn.num_heads, attn.head_size)
+        output = output.view(-1, attn.num_heads, attn.head_size_v)
+        key = key.view(-1, attn.num_kv_heads, attn.head_size)
+        value = value.view(-1, attn.num_kv_heads, attn.head_size_v)
+
+        if (
+            kv_cache_dummy_dep is None
+            and not attn.attn_backend.forward_includes_kv_cache_update
+            and attn.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is None
+        ):
+            unified_kv_cache_update(key, value, attn.layer_name)
+        step5_dsa_attention_with_output(
+            query,
+            key,
+            value,
+            output,
+            attn.layer_name,
+            dsa_proxy_query,
+            dsa_proxy_key,
+            dsa_proxy_weights,
+            dsa_proxy_z,
+            summary_updated,
+            defer_inactive_clear,
+            gate,
+        )
+        return output.view(-1, hidden_size)
+
+    def _sparse_indexer_rope_parameters(
+        self,
+        *,
+        proxy_dim: int,
+        rope_dim: int,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        rope_parameters = dict(self.owner._sparse_indexer_base_rope_parameters)
+        rope_type = str(rope_parameters.get("rope_type", "default")).strip().lower()
+        if rope_type == "none":
+            rope_parameters["rope_type"] = "default"
+        rope_parameters["partial_rotary_factor"] = float(rope_dim) / float(proxy_dim)
+        return rope_parameters
+
+    def _build_sparse_rotary_emb(self) -> nn.Module:
+        rope_dim = int(self.sparse_config.sparse_indexer_rope_dim)
+        proxy_dim = int(self.sparse_config.proxy_dim)
+        return get_rope(
+            head_size=proxy_dim,
+            max_position=self.owner.max_position_embeddings,
+            rope_parameters=self._sparse_indexer_rope_parameters(
+                proxy_dim=proxy_dim,
+                rope_dim=rope_dim,
+            ),
+            dtype=self.owner.params_dtype,
+        )
+
+    def _project_sparse_indexer(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        qkzg: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        decode_slots: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[
+        torch.Tensor,
+        torch.Tensor,
+        torch.Tensor,
+        torch.Tensor,
+        torch.Tensor,
+        bool,
+    ]:
+        from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.indexer_norm_rope import indexer_norm_rope
+
+        owner = self.owner
+        index_q, index_k, index_z, extra_dims = owner.qkv_indexer_proj.split_indexer(
+            qkzg
+        )
+        weights, _ = owner.sparse_indexer_w(hidden_states)
+        cache = (
+            typing.cast(Any, owner.attn.impl).summary_cache
+            if decode_slots is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        index_q, index_k, weights = indexer_norm_rope(
+            index_q,
+            index_k,
+            weights,
+            owner.sparse_indexer_q_norm.weight,
+            owner.sparse_indexer_k_norm.weight,
+            owner.sparse_indexer_k_norm.bias,
+            self.sparse_rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            positions.reshape(-1),
+            owner.sparse_indexer_q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            owner.zero_centered,
+            native_rope=self._indexer_native_rope,
+            num_groups=int(owner.num_kv_heads),
+            decode_cache=cache,
+            decode_z=index_z if cache is not None else None,
+            decode_slots=decode_slots if cache is not None else None,
+        )
+        index_z = index_z.view(int(hidden_states.shape[0]), 1, 256)
+        return index_q, index_k, weights, index_z, extra_dims, cache is not None
+
+
+class Step5MoE(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import FusedMoEFactory
+
+        self.tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+
+        self.ep_size = get_ep_group().device_group.size()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        self.enable_eplb = parallel_config.enable_eplb
+        self.n_routed_experts = config.moe_num_experts
+        self.n_logical_experts = self.n_routed_experts
+        self.n_redundant_experts = parallel_config.eplb_config.num_redundant_experts
+        self.n_physical_experts = self.n_logical_experts + self.n_redundant_experts
+        self.n_local_physical_experts = self.n_physical_experts // self.ep_size
+
+        if self.tp_size > config.moe_num_experts:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Tensor parallel size {self.tp_size} is greater than "
+                f"the number of experts {config.moe_num_experts}."
+            )
+
+        self.gate = GateLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            config.moe_num_experts,
+            bias=False,
+            out_dtype=torch.float32,
+            params_dtype=torch.float32,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate",
+        )
+        if not config.use_moe_router_bias:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 MoE currently requires use_moe_router_bias=true.")
+        self.router_bias = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.zeros(config.moe_num_experts, dtype=torch.float32),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        )
+        if not config.need_fp32_gate:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 MoE requires need_fp32_gate=true for stable router logits."
+            )
+
+        activation = "silu"
+        swiglu_limits = config.swiglu_limits or []
+        swiglu_limit = (
+            swiglu_limits[self.layer_idx]
+            if self.layer_idx < len(swiglu_limits)
+            else None
+        )
+        if swiglu_limit not in (None, 0):
+            if not isinstance(swiglu_limit, (int, float)):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Step5 swiglu_limits entries must be numeric, got "
+                    f"{swiglu_limit!r}."
+                )
+            swiglu_limit = float(swiglu_limit)
+            if swiglu_limit != 7.0:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Step5 fused MoE supports only swiglu_limit=7.0, got "
+                    f"{swiglu_limit}."
+                )
+            activation = "swiglustep"
+
+        self.fuse_all_reduce, reduce_results = _step5_moe_reduce_policy(
+            self.tp_size,
+            get_dp_group().world_size,
+        )
+
+        kernel_config = getattr(vllm_config, "kernel_config", None)
+        self.use_mega_moe = (
+            getattr(kernel_config, "moe_backend", "auto") == "deep_gemm_mega_moe"
+        )
+        self.use_sequence_parallel = _step5_use_sequence_parallel(vllm_config)
+        if self.use_mega_moe:
+            self.fuse_all_reduce, reduce_results = False, False
+
+        self.share_expert = Step5MLP(
+            config=config,
+            hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.share_expert_dim,
+            hidden_act="silu",
+            reduce_results=reduce_results,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.share_expert",
+            sequence_parallel=self.use_sequence_parallel,
+            can_shard_sequence_parallel=self.use_mega_moe,
+            reduce_in_fp32=True,
+        )
+        # Step5 selects experts with a correction bias but computes routed
+        # weights from the unbiased sigmoid scores.
+        expert_kwargs = dict(
+            num_experts=config.moe_num_experts,
+            top_k=config.moe_top_k,
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.moe_intermediate_size,
+            renormalize=config.norm_expert_weight,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            activation=activation,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.experts",
+            scoring_func=getattr(config, "moe_router_activation", "sigmoid"),
+            e_score_correction_bias=self.router_bias,
+            routed_scaling_factor=config.moe_router_scaling_factor,
+        )
+        if self.use_mega_moe:
+            from vllm.models.step5.nvidia.mega_moe import Step5MegaMoE
+
+            self.experts = Step5MegaMoE(
+                vllm_config,
+                **expert_kwargs,
+                activation_clamp=swiglu_limit or None,
+                sequence_parallel=self.use_sequence_parallel,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.experts = FusedMoEFactory(
+                **expert_kwargs,
+                reduce_results=reduce_results,
+                enable_eplb=self.enable_eplb,
+                num_redundant_experts=self.n_redundant_experts,
+                router_logits_dtype=torch.float32,
+            )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        padding: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor]:
+        hidden_dim = hidden_states.shape[-1]
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.view(-1, hidden_dim)
+
+        shared_output = self.share_expert(hidden_states)
+
+        router_logits, _ = self.gate(hidden_states)
+        expert_kwargs = {"padding": padding} if padding is not None else {}
+        routed_output = self.experts(
+            hidden_states=hidden_states, router_logits=router_logits, **expert_kwargs
+        )
+
+        return shared_output, routed_output
+

+class Step5DecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
+        cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        # Preserve the configured SWA window before clearing the per-layer
+        # cache copy; layer_types determines which layers use it.
+        sliding_window = getattr(config, "sliding_window", None)
+        if sliding_window is None:
+            # Multimodal checkpoints keep sliding_window in the text config.
+            sliding_window = getattr(
+                vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config, "sliding_window", None
+            )
+        if sliding_window is None and cache_config is not None:
+            sliding_window = cache_config.sliding_window
+        if cache_config is not None:
+            cache_config = copy.copy(cache_config)
+            cache_config.sliding_window = None
+        sparse_config = get_step5_sparse_config(config)
+        if not checkpoint_has_step5_sparse_config(config):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Step5 requires a checkpoint with a sparse_config section; "
+                "dense-only checkpoints are not supported."
+            )
+        use_dsa_for_layer = (
+            sparse_config is not None
+            and _is_step5_full_attention_layer(config, layer_idx, sparse_config)
+        )
+        if config.att_impl_type == "GQA":
+            norm_dtype = get_step5_norm_dtype(config)
+            num_attention_heads = None
+            num_attention_groups = None
+            head_dim = None
+            layer_types = _get_step5_layer_types(config)
+            if (
+                getattr(config, "attention_other_setting", None)
+                and layer_idx < len(layer_types)
+                and layer_types[layer_idx]
+                == config.attention_other_setting["attention_type"]
+            ):
+                num_attention_heads = config.attention_other_setting[
+                    "num_attention_heads"
+                ]
+                num_attention_groups = config.attention_other_setting[
+                    "num_attention_groups"
+                ]
+                head_dim = config.attention_other_setting["head_dim"]
+            partial_rotary_factors = getattr(config, "partial_rotary_factors", [])
+            partial_rotary_factor = float(
+                _per_layer_value(
+                    partial_rotary_factors,
+                    layer_idx,
+                    name="partial_rotary_factors",
+                    default=1.0,
+                )
+            )
+            max_position = getattr(config, "max_position_embeddings", None)
+            if max_position is None:
+                max_position = vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+            self.self_attn = Step5Attention(
+                hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+                num_heads=num_attention_heads
+                if num_attention_heads
+                else config.num_attention_heads,
+                max_position=max_position,
+                num_kv_heads=num_attention_groups
+                if num_attention_groups
+                else config.num_attention_groups,
+                rope_theta=config.rope_theta,
+                rms_norm_eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+                qkv_bias=getattr(config, "attention_bias", False),
+                head_dim=head_dim if head_dim else getattr(config, "head_dim", None),
+                cache_config=cache_config,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                rope_scaling=getattr(config, "rope_scaling", None),
+                sliding_window=sliding_window,
+                use_head_wise_attn_gate=getattr(
+                    config, "use_head_wise_attn_gate", False
+                ),
+                layer_types=layer_types,
+                use_rope_layers=getattr(config, "use_rope_layers", []),
+                yarn_only_types=getattr(config, "yarn_only_types", []),
+                swa_num_attention_heads=getattr(
+                    config, "swa_num_attention_heads", None
+                ),
+                partial_rotary_factor=partial_rotary_factor,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+                zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+                vllm_config=vllm_config,
+                sparse_config=sparse_config if use_dsa_for_layer else None,
+                norm_dtype=norm_dtype,
+            )
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Unsupported attention implementation: {config.att_impl_type}"
+            )
+        self.use_sequence_parallel = _step5_use_sequence_parallel(vllm_config)
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            self.self_attn.o_proj.reduce_results = False
+        self.use_moe = False
+        self.tp_group = get_tp_group()
+        self.use_fused_all_reduce = (
+            get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size() > 1
+            and get_dp_group().world_size == 1
+            and not self.use_sequence_parallel
+        )
+
+        moe_layers_idx = _get_step5_moe_layer_indices(config)
+        if layer_idx in moe_layers_idx:
+            self.moe = Step5MoE(
+                vllm_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.moe",
+            )
+            self.use_moe = True
+        else:
+            self.mlp = Step5MLP(
+                config=config,
+                hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size=config.intermediate_size,
+                hidden_act="silu",
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                reduce_results=True,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                sequence_parallel=self.use_sequence_parallel,
+                can_shard_sequence_parallel=True,
+            )
+        self.input_layernorm = make_step5_rms_norm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+            dtype=norm_dtype,
+        )
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = make_step5_rms_norm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+            dtype=norm_dtype,
+        )
+
+    def _add_for_residual(self, in1: torch.Tensor, in2: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.fp32_residual_connection:
+            return add_fp32(in1, in2)
+        return in1 + in2
+
+    def _cast_for_param_op(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not self.fp32_residual_connection:
+            return hidden_states
+        return hidden_states.to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+    def _cast_for_residual(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not self.fp32_residual_connection:
+            return hidden_states
+        return hidden_states.to(torch.float32)
+
+    def _forward_ffn(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        padding: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.use_moe:
+            shared_output, moe_output = self.moe(hidden_states, padding=padding)
+            combined = (
+                moe_output
+                if shared_output is None
+                else self._add_for_residual(moe_output, shared_output)
+            )
+            # Reduce once when both branches defer reduction; otherwise their
+            # outputs are already reduced.
+            if self.moe.fuse_all_reduce:
+                if self.use_fused_all_reduce:
+                    combined = self.tp_group.all_reduce(combined)
+                else:
+                    combined = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(combined)
+            return combined
+        return self.mlp(hidden_states)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        padding: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if self.fp32_residual_connection and isinstance(
+            self.input_layernorm, Step5RMSNorm
+        ):
+            if residual is None:
+                residual = hidden_states
+                hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(
+                    hidden_states, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )
+            else:
+                hidden_states, residual = self.input_layernorm(
+                    hidden_states, residual, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )
+        else:
+            if residual is not None:
+                hidden_states = self._add_for_residual(hidden_states, residual)
+            residual = hidden_states
+            hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)
+            hidden_states = self._cast_for_param_op(hidden_states)
+
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sp_all_gather(hidden_states)[: positions.shape[0]]
+        hidden_states = self.self_attn(
+            positions=positions,
+            hidden_states=hidden_states,
+        )
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sp_reduce_scatter(hidden_states)
+        if self.fp32_residual_connection and isinstance(
+            self.post_attention_layernorm, Step5RMSNorm
+        ):
+            hidden_states, residual = self.post_attention_layernorm(
+                hidden_states, residual, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16
+            )
+        else:
+            hidden_states = self._cast_for_residual(hidden_states)
+            hidden_states += residual
+            residual = hidden_states
+            hidden_states = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states)
+            hidden_states = self._cast_for_param_op(hidden_states)
+
+        ffn_output = self._forward_ffn(hidden_states, padding=padding)
+        return ffn_output, residual
+

+class Step5Model(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+
+        self.use_sequence_parallel = _step5_use_sequence_parallel(vllm_config)
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.vocab_size = config.vocab_size
+        self.config = config
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        self.moe_num_experts = config.moe_num_experts
+
+        if get_pp_group().is_first_rank or (
+            config.tie_word_embeddings and get_pp_group().is_last_rank
+        ):
+            self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+                self.vocab_size,
+                config.hidden_size,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.embed_tokens = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.start_layer, self.end_layer, self.layers = make_layers(
+            config.num_hidden_layers,
+            lambda prefix: Step5DecoderLayer(
+                vllm_config,
+                prefix=prefix,
+            ),
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.layers",
+        )
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            norm_dtype = get_step5_norm_dtype(config)
+            self.norm = make_step5_rms_norm(
+                config.hidden_size,
+                eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+                zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+                dtype=norm_dtype,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.norm = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = make_empty_intermediate_tensors_factory(
+            ["hidden_states"], config.hidden_size
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+    def _cast_for_residual(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not self.fp32_residual_connection:
+            return hidden_states
+        return hidden_states.to(torch.float32)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if get_pp_group().is_first_rank:
+            if inputs_embeds is not None:
+                hidden_states = inputs_embeds
+            else:
+                hidden_states = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        else:
+            assert intermediate_tensors is not None
+            hidden_states = intermediate_tensors["hidden_states"]
+        hidden_states = self._cast_for_residual(hidden_states)
+        padding = None
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            padding = _step5_sp_padding(hidden_states)
+            hidden_states = sp_shard(hidden_states)
+        residual = None
+        for i in range(self.start_layer, self.end_layer):
+            layer = self.layers[i]
+            hidden_states, residual = layer(
+                positions, hidden_states, residual, padding=padding
+            )
+        if residual is not None:
+            hidden_states = layer._add_for_residual(hidden_states, residual)
+        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sp_all_gather(hidden_states)[: positions.shape[0]]
+
+        if not get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            return IntermediateTensors(
+                {
+                    "hidden_states": hidden_states,
+                }
+            )
+
+        return hidden_states
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import (
+            default_weight_loader,
+            maybe_remap_kv_scale_name,
+        )
+
+        config = self.config
+        if config.num_attention_groups <= 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 weight loading currently supports only GQA "
+                "(num_attention_groups > 1)."
+            )
+
+        params_dict = dict(self.named_parameters())
+        loaded_params: set[str] = set()
+        # Quantized expert wrappers insert base_layer into parameter names.
+        base_layer = (
+            "base_layer." if any(".base_layer." in name for name in params_dict) else ""
+        )
+        # Packed 3D format: .moe.gate_proj.weight [num_experts, out, in]. Each
+        # entry is a substring of its scale names (weight_scale_inv, ...), so
+        # it maps those too.
+        expert_params_mapping = [
+            (
+                f".moe.experts.routed_experts.{base_layer}w13_weight",
+                ".moe.gate_proj.weight",
+                "w1",
+            ),
+            (
+                f".moe.experts.routed_experts.{base_layer}w13_weight",
+                ".moe.up_proj.weight",
+                "w3",
+            ),
+            (
+                f".moe.experts.routed_experts.{base_layer}w2_weight",
+                ".moe.down_proj.weight",
+                "w2",
+            ),
+        ]
+
+        expert_params_mapping += [
+            (
+                param.replace("_weight", "_input_scale"),
+                weight.replace(".weight", ".input_scale"),
+                shard,
+            )
+            for param, weight, shard in expert_params_mapping
+        ]
+
+        disable_moe_stacked_params = [data[1] for data in expert_params_mapping]
+
+        def _load_weight(name: str, loaded_weight: torch.Tensor) -> set[str]:
+            loaded_params: set[str] = set()
+            if name.startswith("model."):
+                local_name = name[len("model.") :]
+                full_name = name
+            else:
+                local_name = name
+                full_name = f"model.{name}" if name else "model"
+
+            if full_name.startswith("model.layers."):
+                layer_prefix = ".".join(full_name.split(".", 3)[:3])
+                layer_idx = extract_layer_index(layer_prefix)
+                if layer_idx >= config.num_hidden_layers:
+                    return loaded_params
+
+            remapped_name = maybe_remap_kv_scale_name(local_name, params_dict)
+            if remapped_name is None:
+                return loaded_params
+            local_name = remapped_name
+
+            if ".moe.experts." in local_name:
+                if is_pp_missing_parameter(local_name, self):
+                    return loaded_params
+                if local_name not in params_dict:
+                    raise NotImplementedError(
+                        f"Unsupported Step5 MoE checkpoint tensor {name!r}: only "
+                        "the packed 3D expert format is supported."
+                    )
+                param = params_dict[local_name]
+                getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)(
+                    param, loaded_weight
+                )
+                loaded_params.add(local_name)
+                return loaded_params
+            for param_name, weight_name, stacked_shard_id in _STEP5_WEIGHT_SHARDS:
+                if weight_name not in local_name:
+                    continue
+                if any(
+                    disable_moe_stacked_param in local_name
+                    for disable_moe_stacked_param in disable_moe_stacked_params
+                ):
+                    continue
+                replaced_name = local_name.replace(weight_name, param_name)
+                if is_pp_missing_parameter(replaced_name, self):
+                    continue
+                if replaced_name not in params_dict:
+                    continue
+                param = params_dict[replaced_name]
+                weight_loader = param.weight_loader
+                weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, stacked_shard_id)
+                loaded_params.add(replaced_name)
+                break
+            else:
+                for param_name, weight_name, shard_id in expert_params_mapping:
+                    if weight_name not in local_name:
+                        continue
+                    replaced_name = local_name.replace(weight_name, param_name)
+                    if is_pp_missing_parameter(replaced_name, self):
+                        continue
+                    if (
+                        replaced_name.endswith(".bias")
+                        or replaced_name.endswith("_bias")
+                    ) and replaced_name not in params_dict:
+                        continue
+                    if replaced_name not in params_dict:
+                        continue
+                    param = params_dict[replaced_name]
+                    weight_loader = param.weight_loader
+                    moe_expert_num = self.moe_num_experts
+                    if (
+                        loaded_weight.ndim == 0
+                        or loaded_weight.shape[0] != moe_expert_num
+                    ):
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            "Step5 expert tensor has an unexpected leading "
+                            f"dimension: expected {moe_expert_num}, got "
+                            f"{tuple(loaded_weight.shape)} for {replaced_name}."
+                        )
+                    for expert_id in range(moe_expert_num):
+                        weight_loader(
+                            param,
+                            loaded_weight[expert_id],
+                            replaced_name,
+                            shard_id=shard_id,
+                            expert_id=expert_id,
+                        )
+                    loaded_params.add(replaced_name)
+                    break
+                else:
+                    if is_pp_missing_parameter(local_name, self):
+                        return loaded_params
+                    if "expert_bias" in local_name:
+                        logger.warning_once("Ignoring unsupported expert_bias weight.")
+                        return loaded_params
+                    if local_name not in params_dict:
+                        return loaded_params
+                    param = params_dict[local_name]
+                    fallback_weight_loader = getattr(
+                        param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader
+                    )
+                    try:
+                        fallback_weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
+                    except Exception:
+                        logger.error(
+                            "Failed to load %s: checkpoint shape=%s, "
+                            "parameter shape=%s",
+                            local_name,
+                            tuple(loaded_weight.shape),
+                            tuple(param.shape),
+                        )
+                        raise
+
+                    loaded_params.add(local_name)
+            return loaded_params
+
+        for name, loaded_weight in skip_spec_layers(weights, config):
+            loaded_params.update(_load_weight(name, loaded_weight))
+        return loaded_params
+
+
+class Step5ForCausalLM(nn.Module, SupportsPP, MixtureOfExperts):
+    # Required so quantization exclude lists match fused module prefixes.
+    packed_modules_mapping = STEP5_PACKED_MODULES_MAPPING
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_model_state_cls():
+        from .model_state import Step5ModelState
+
+        return Step5ModelState
+
+    # The custom loader returns the complete loaded-parameter set.
+    _enable_weights_track_by_default = True
+
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_regex={
+            re.compile(r"^vit_large_projector\.weight$"): None,
+        },
+        orig_to_new_substr={".share_expert.": ".moe.share_expert."},
+    )
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+        config = model_config.hf_config
+        self.config = config
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        self.model = Step5Model(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model")
+        )
+        self.num_moe_layers: int
+        self.num_expert_groups: int
+        self.num_shared_experts: int
+        self.num_logical_experts: int
+        self.num_physical_experts: int
+        self.num_local_physical_experts: int
+        self.num_routed_experts: int
+        self.num_redundant_experts: int
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+                config.vocab_size,
+                config.hidden_size,
+                quant_config=vllm_config.quant_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+            )
+            if config.tie_word_embeddings:
+                self.lm_head = self.lm_head.tie_weights(self.model.embed_tokens)
+            self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config.vocab_size)
+        else:
+            self.lm_head = PPMissingLayer()

+        example_layer: Step5MoE | None = None
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            if isinstance(layer, PPMissingLayer):
+                continue
+            assert isinstance(layer, Step5DecoderLayer)
+            if hasattr(layer, "moe") and isinstance(layer.moe, Step5MoE):
+                example_layer = layer.moe
+                self.moe_layers.append(layer.moe.experts)
+
+        _set_step5_moe_protocol_metadata(self, example_layer)
+
+    def make_empty_intermediate_tensors(
+        self,
+        batch_size: int,
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> IntermediateTensors:
+        return self.model.make_empty_intermediate_tensors(batch_size, dtype, device)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ):
+        return self.model(input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, inputs_embeds)
+
+    def compute_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.fp32_residual_connection:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states.to(torch.bfloat16)
+        hidden_states = self.model.norm(hidden_states)
+        return self.logits_processor(self.lm_head, hidden_states)
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+    def update_physical_experts_metadata(
+        self,
+        num_physical_experts: int,
+        num_local_physical_experts: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        if self.num_local_physical_experts != num_local_physical_experts:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 EPLB cannot change the number of local physical experts: "
+                f"expected={self.num_local_physical_experts}, "
+                f"got={num_local_physical_experts}."
+            )
+        self.num_physical_experts = num_physical_experts
+        self.num_local_physical_experts = num_local_physical_experts
+        self.num_redundant_experts = num_physical_experts - self.num_logical_experts
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            if isinstance(layer, PPMissingLayer):
+                continue
+            if not isinstance(layer, Step5DecoderLayer):
+                continue
+            moe = getattr(layer, "moe", None)
+            if not isinstance(moe, Step5MoE):
+                continue
+            moe.n_local_physical_experts = num_local_physical_experts
+            moe.n_physical_experts = num_physical_experts
+            moe.n_redundant_experts = self.num_redundant_experts
+            moe.experts.update_expert_map()
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.mtp_validation import (
+            is_mtp_completeness_check_enabled,
+        )
+
+        validate_completeness = is_mtp_completeness_check_enabled()
+        if validate_completeness:
+            _reset_fused_qkv_indexer_load_state(self.model)
+        skip_prefixes = ["vision_model."]
+        if self.config.tie_word_embeddings:
+            skip_prefixes.append("lm_head.")
+        mapper = self.hf_to_vllm_mapper | WeightsMapper(
+            orig_to_new_prefix={prefix: None for prefix in skip_prefixes}
+        )
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        loaded_params = loader.load_weights(weights, mapper=mapper)
+        if validate_completeness:
+            loaded_params.update(
+                f"model.{name}"
+                for name in _validate_fused_qkv_indexer_weights(self.model)
+            )
+        return loaded_params

+"""MRv2 model state that exposes persistent request indices to Step5 DSA."""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheConfig
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.input_batch import InputBatch
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.default import DefaultModelState
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.interface import ModelSpecificAttnMetadata
+from vllm.v1.worker.utils import AttentionGroup
+
+
+class Step5ModelState(DefaultModelState):
+    """DefaultModelState plus request state indices for DSA speculative undo.
+
+    DSA summaries keep a per-request undo journal so a rejected draft window
+    can be rolled back on device. Journal rows are addressed by the persistent
+    request state index, which must stay at a fixed address for FULL CUDA
+    graph replay; padded batch rows are -1.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, model, encoder_cache, device):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, model, encoder_cache, device)
+        self.request_state = torch.full(
+            (self.max_num_reqs,), -1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+        )
+
+    def prepare_attn(
+        self,
+        input_batch: InputBatch,
+        cudagraph_mode: CUDAGraphMode,
+        block_tables: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+        slot_mappings: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_groups: list[list[AttentionGroup]],
+        kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig,
+        for_capture: bool = False,
+        ubatch_idx: int = 0,
+        model_specific_attn_metadata: ModelSpecificAttnMetadata | None = None,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        from .sparse_attention import Step5DSAMetadataBuilder
+
+        num_reqs = input_batch.num_reqs
+        self.request_state[num_reqs:].fill_(-1)
+        self.request_state[:num_reqs].copy_(input_batch.idx_mapping)
+        for groups in attn_groups:
+            for group in groups:
+                builder = group.get_metadata_builder(ubatch_idx)
+                if isinstance(builder, Step5DSAMetadataBuilder):
+                    builder.step5_request_state = self.request_state
+        return super().prepare_attn(
+            input_batch,
+            cudagraph_mode,
+            block_tables,
+            slot_mappings,
+            attn_groups,
+            kv_cache_config,
+            for_capture=for_capture,
+            ubatch_idx=ubatch_idx,
+            model_specific_attn_metadata=model_specific_attn_metadata,
+        )

+    VocabParallelEmbedding,

+    SupportsMultiModal,

+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)

+
+def _get_mtp_vllm_config(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> VllmConfig:
+    speculative_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if speculative_config is None or speculative_config.draft_model_config is None:
+        return vllm_config
+    return replace(vllm_config, model_config=speculative_config.draft_model_config)
+
+
+def _get_mtp_config(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> PreTrainedConfig:
+    return _get_mtp_vllm_config(vllm_config).model_config.hf_text_config
+
+
+def _build_mtp_norm(config: PreTrainedConfig) -> nn.Module:
+    return Step5RMSNorm(
+        config.hidden_size,
+        eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+        zero_centered=config.zero_centered,
+        dtype=get_step5_norm_dtype(config),
+    )
+
+
+class Step5MTPSharedHead(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: PreTrainedConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        # Keep MTP normalization and residual precision aligned with the target
+        # model configuration.
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        self.norm = _build_mtp_norm(config)
+        self.head = ParallelLMHead(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.head",
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.fp32_residual_connection:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states.to(torch.bfloat16)
+        return self.norm(hidden_states)
+
+
+class Step5MultiTokenPredictorLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        mtp_vllm_config = _get_mtp_vllm_config(vllm_config)
+        config = mtp_vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+        self.fp32_residual_connection = config.fp32_residual_connection
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        self.enorm = _build_mtp_norm(config)
+        self.hnorm = _build_mtp_norm(config)
+        self.eh_proj = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size * 2, config.hidden_size, bias=False)
+        self.shared_head = Step5MTPSharedHead(
+            config=config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.shared_head"
+        )
+        self.mtp_block = Step5DecoderLayer(
+            mtp_vllm_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.mtp_block",
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        previous_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        spec_step_index: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert inputs_embeds is not None
+        if (
+            inputs_embeds.is_cuda
+            and previous_hidden_states.device == inputs_embeds.device
+            and inputs_embeds.ndim == previous_hidden_states.ndim == 2
+            and inputs_embeds.shape == previous_hidden_states.shape
+            and inputs_embeds.stride(-1) == previous_hidden_states.stride(-1) == 1
+            and 0 < inputs_embeds.shape[-1] <= 16384
+            and inputs_embeds.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and previous_hidden_states.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)
+            and self.fp32_residual_connection
+        ):
+            from .ops.mtp_norm import norm_concat
+
+            eh_input = norm_concat(
+                inputs_embeds,
+                previous_hidden_states,
+                self.enorm.weight,
+                self.hnorm.weight,
+                self.enorm.variance_epsilon,
+                self.enorm.zero_centered,
+                self.fp32_residual_connection,
+            )
+        else:
+            if self.fp32_residual_connection:
+                inputs_embeds = inputs_embeds.to(torch.bfloat16)
+                previous_hidden_states = previous_hidden_states.to(torch.bfloat16)
+            eh_input = torch.cat(
+                [self.enorm(inputs_embeds), self.hnorm(previous_hidden_states)], dim=-1
+            )
+
+        hidden_states = self.eh_proj(eh_input)
+        if self.fp32_residual_connection:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states.to(torch.float32)
+        padding = None
+        if self.mtp_block.use_sequence_parallel:
+            padding = _step5_sp_padding(hidden_states)
+            hidden_states = sp_shard(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states, residual = self.mtp_block(
+            positions=positions, hidden_states=hidden_states, padding=padding
+        )
+        hidden_states = self.mtp_block._add_for_residual(hidden_states, residual)
+        if self.mtp_block.use_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sp_all_gather(hidden_states)[: positions.shape[0]]
+        return hidden_states
+
+
+class Step5MultiTokenPredictor(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        super().__init__()
+        config = _get_mtp_config(vllm_config)
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+        )
+        self.mtp_start_layer_idx = config.num_hidden_layers
+        self.num_mtp_layers = config.num_nextn_predict_layers
+        if self.num_mtp_layers <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 MTP requires num_nextn_predict_layers > 0, got "
+                f"{self.num_mtp_layers}."
+            )
+        self.layers = torch.nn.ModuleDict(
+            {
+                str(idx): Step5MultiTokenPredictorLayer(
+                    vllm_config=vllm_config,
+                    prefix=f"{prefix}.layers.{idx}",
+                )
+                for idx in range(
+                    self.mtp_start_layer_idx,
+                    self.mtp_start_layer_idx + self.num_mtp_layers,
+                )
+            }
+        )
+
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config.vocab_size)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        previous_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if inputs_embeds is None:
+            inputs_embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        current_step_idx = spec_step_idx % self.num_mtp_layers
+        return self.layers[str(self.mtp_start_layer_idx + current_step_idx)](
+            input_ids,
+            positions,
+            previous_hidden_states,
+            inputs_embeds,
+            current_step_idx,
+        )
+
+    def compute_logits(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        current_step_idx = spec_step_idx % self.num_mtp_layers
+        mtp_layer = self.layers[str(self.mtp_start_layer_idx + current_step_idx)]
+        return self.logits_processor(
+            mtp_layer.shared_head.head, mtp_layer.shared_head(hidden_states)
+        )
+
+    def get_top_tokens(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        current_step_idx = spec_step_idx % self.num_mtp_layers
+        mtp_layer = self.layers[str(self.mtp_start_layer_idx + current_step_idx)]
+        return self.logits_processor.get_top_tokens(
+            mtp_layer.shared_head.head,
+            mtp_layer.shared_head(hidden_states),
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.get_input_embeddings(input_ids)
+
+    def get_input_embeddings(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+
+def _get_step5_mtp_moe_blocks(
+    model: Step5MultiTokenPredictor,
+) -> list[Step5MoE]:
+    blocks: list[Step5MoE] = []
+    for predictor_layer in model.layers.values():
+        mtp_block = getattr(predictor_layer, "mtp_block", None)
+        moe = getattr(mtp_block, "moe", None)
+        if isinstance(moe, Step5MoE):
+            blocks.append(moe)
+    return blocks
+
+
+def _is_step5_mtp_dense(model: Step5MultiTokenPredictor) -> bool:
+    """Return whether every draft transformer block is dense."""
+    return not _get_step5_mtp_moe_blocks(model)
+
+
+class Step5MTP(nn.Module, MixtureOfExperts, SupportsMultiModal):
+    supports_multimodal_embeddings = True
+    has_own_lm_head = True
+    packed_modules_mapping = STEP5_PACKED_MODULES_MAPPING
+    _enable_weights_track_by_default = True
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        super().__init__()
+        # The target VL model maps quantization exclusions to language_model.*.
+        # Draft modules live at model.* and must not mutate the target config.
+        if vllm_config.quant_config is not None:
+            quant_config = deepcopy(vllm_config.quant_config)
+            quant_config.apply_vllm_mapper(
+                WeightsMapper(orig_to_new_prefix={"language_model.": ""})
+            )
+            vllm_config = replace(vllm_config, quant_config=quant_config)
+        self.config = _get_mtp_config(vllm_config)
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        self.model = Step5MultiTokenPredictor(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model")
+        )
+        # Expose the first draft head to the generic sharing policy. Each MTP
+        # layer retains its own checkpoint head for compute_logits.
+        self.lm_head = self.model.layers[
+            str(self.model.mtp_start_layer_idx)
+        ].shared_head.head
+        self.num_moe_layers: int
+        self.num_expert_groups: int
+        self.num_shared_experts: int
+        self.num_logical_experts: int
+        self.num_physical_experts: int
+        self.num_local_physical_experts: int
+        self.num_routed_experts: int
+        self.num_redundant_experts: int
+        if not _is_step5_mtp_dense(self.model):
+            raise NotImplementedError("Step5 MTP supports dense draft layers only")
+        # Dense MTP forwards must not inherit the target model's DP collectives.
+        self.is_dense_mtp = True
+        self.moe_layers = []
+        _set_step5_moe_protocol_metadata(self, None)
+
+    def embed_input_ids(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        multimodal_embeddings: MultiModalEmbeddings | None = None,
+        *,
+        is_multimodal: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        inputs_embeds = self._embed_text_input_ids(
+            input_ids, self.model.embed_input_ids, is_multimodal=is_multimodal
+        )
+        if multimodal_embeddings is None or len(multimodal_embeddings) == 0:
+            return inputs_embeds
+        return _merge_multimodal_embeddings(
+            inputs_embeds=inputs_embeds,
+            multimodal_embeddings=multimodal_embeddings,
+            is_multimodal=_require_is_multimodal(is_multimodal),
+        )
+
+    def get_input_embeddings(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.get_input_embeddings(input_ids)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model(
+            input_ids, positions, hidden_states, inputs_embeds, spec_step_idx
+        )
+
+    def compute_logits(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.model.compute_logits(hidden_states, spec_step_idx)
+
+    def get_top_tokens(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.get_top_tokens(hidden_states, spec_step_idx)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.mtp_validation import (
+            is_mtp_completeness_check_enabled,
+        )
+        from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import (
+            default_weight_loader,
+        )
+
+        validate_completeness = is_mtp_completeness_check_enabled()
+        if validate_completeness:
+            _reset_fused_qkv_indexer_load_state(self)
+        params_dict = dict(self.named_parameters())
+
+        loaded_params: set[str] = set()
+        for name, loaded_weight in weights:
+            if "rotary_emb.inv_freq" in name:
+                continue
+            if name.startswith("layers."):
+                name = f"model.{name}"
+            spec_layer = get_spec_layer_idx_from_weight_name(self.config, name)
+            if "embed_tokens" not in name and spec_layer is None:
+                continue
+            name = self._rewrite_spec_layer_name(spec_layer, name)
+            for param_name, weight_name, shard_id in _STEP5_WEIGHT_SHARDS:
+                if weight_name not in name or "experts" in name or "moe" in name:
+                    continue
+                replaced_name = name.replace(weight_name, param_name)
+                if replaced_name not in params_dict:
+                    continue
+                name = replaced_name
+                param = params_dict[name]
+                weight_loader = param.weight_loader
+                weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, shard_id)
+                break
+            else:
+                # Skip loading extra bias for GPTQ models.
+                if (
+                    name.endswith(".bias")
+                    and name not in params_dict
+                    or "tok_embeddings" in name
+                ):
+                    continue
+
+                if spec_layer is not None and ".transformer." in name:
+                    name = name.replace(".transformer.", ".")
+                if "shared_head" in name:
+                    name = name.replace("shared_head.output", "shared_head.head")
+                if "embed_tokens" in name:
+                    name = "model.embed_tokens.weight"
+                if name not in params_dict:
+                    logger.warning_once(
+                        "Skipping unexpected MTP checkpoint weight: %s", name
+                    )
+                    continue
+                param = params_dict[name]
+                weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
+                weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
+            loaded_params.add(name)
+        if validate_completeness:
+            loaded_params.update(_validate_fused_qkv_indexer_weights(self))
+        missing_params = set(params_dict).difference(loaded_params)
+        if missing_params and validate_completeness:
+            param_name_example = min(missing_params)
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Some parameters like "
+                f"{param_name_example} are not in the checkpoint and will falsely "
+                "use random initialization"
+            )
+        return loaded_params
+
+    def _rewrite_spec_layer_name(self, spec_layer: int | None, name: str) -> str:
+        """Rewrite the weight name to match the format of the original model.
+        Add .mtp_block for modules in transformer layer block for spec layer
+        """
+        spec_layer_weight_names = [
+            "embed_tokens",
+            "enorm",
+            "hnorm",
+            "eh_proj",
+            "shared_head",
+        ]
+        spec_layer_weight = False
+        for weight_name in spec_layer_weight_names:
+            if weight_name in name:
+                spec_layer_weight = True
+                break
+        if not spec_layer_weight:
+            name = name.replace(
+                f"model.layers.{spec_layer}.", f"model.layers.{spec_layer}.mtp_block."
+            )
+        return name

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Add low-precision tensors without materializing their FP32 conversions."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["N"])
+def _add_fp32(X, Y, Output, N, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    offset = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    x = tl.load(X + offset, offset < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    y = tl.load(Y + offset, offset < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(Output + offset, x + y, offset < N)
+
+
+def add_fp32(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return x.float() + y.float(), preserving the FP32 addition."""
+    if (
+        not x.is_cuda
+        or x.device != y.device
+        or x.shape != y.shape
+        or not x.is_contiguous()
+        or not y.is_contiguous()
+        or x.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32)
+        or y.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32)
+        or (x.dtype == torch.float32 and y.dtype == torch.float32)
+    ):
+        return x.float() + y.float()
+    output = torch.empty_like(x, dtype=torch.float32)
+    if x.numel():
+        _add_fp32[(triton.cdiv(x.numel(), 1024),)](
+            x, y, output, x.numel(), 1024, enable_fp_fusion=False
+        )
+    return output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Normalize MTP embedding and hidden states directly into the projection input."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _norm_concat(
+    E,
+    H,
+    EW,
+    HW,
+    Output,
+    ES: tl.constexpr,
+    HS: tl.constexpr,
+    D: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    ZERO_CENTERED: tl.constexpr,
+    ROUND_BF16: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    e = tl.load(E + row * ES + col, col < D, other=0)
+    h = tl.load(H + row * HS + col, col < D, other=0)
+    if ROUND_BF16:
+        e = e.to(tl.bfloat16)
+        h = h.to(tl.bfloat16)
+    e = e.to(tl.float32)
+    h = h.to(tl.float32)
+    ew = tl.load(EW + col, col < D, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    hw = tl.load(HW + col, col < D, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    if ZERO_CENTERED:
+        ew = ew + 1.0
+        hw = hw + 1.0
+    e = (e * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(e * e, 0) / D + EPS)) * ew
+    h = (h * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(h * h, 0) / D + EPS)) * hw
+    tl.store(Output + row * (2 * D) + col, e, col < D)
+    tl.store(Output + row * (2 * D) + D + col, h, col < D)
+
+
+def norm_concat(
+    embeds: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    embed_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    zero_centered: bool,
+    fp32_residual_connection: bool,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Preserve the BF16 input rounding used with FP32 residual connections."""
+    dtype = (
+        torch.bfloat16
+        if fp32_residual_connection
+        else torch.promote_types(embeds.dtype, hidden.dtype)
+    )
+    output = torch.empty(
+        (embeds.shape[0], 2 * embeds.shape[1]), device=embeds.device, dtype=dtype
+    )
+    if embeds.shape[0]:
+        _norm_concat[(embeds.shape[0],)](
+            embeds,
+            hidden,
+            embed_weight,
+            hidden_weight,
+            output,
+            embeds.stride(0),
+            hidden.stride(0),
+            embeds.shape[1],
+            eps,
+            zero_centered,
+            fp32_residual_connection,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(embeds.shape[1]),
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Step-local indexer metadata shared across sparse attention layers."""
+
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.sparse_indexer import (
+    PagedPrefillMetadata,
+    _emit_all_regions,
+    _emit_indexer_schedule,
+    _emit_prefill_pages,
+)
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+class PrefillIndexerMetadata(NamedTuple):
+    current: torch.Tensor
+    lengths: torch.Tensor
+    topk_lengths: torch.Tensor
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    schedule: torch.Tensor | None
+    selected: torch.Tensor | None
+
+
+# Row, page and region counts follow the prompt; keep them runtime values so
+# each new prompt length does not recompile.
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["ROWS", "PAGES", "REGIONS"])
+def _prepare_prefill_indexer(
+    Owners,
+    Positions,
+    Current,
+    Lengths,
+    TopKLengths,
+    Table,
+    Schedules,
+    Selected,
+    ROWS,
+    PAGES,
+    OWNER_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    POSITION_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_SMS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SMS: tl.constexpr,
+    NEED_SCORES: tl.constexpr,
+    REGIONS,
+    BLOCK_REGIONS: tl.constexpr,
+    CHUNK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    SEARCH_STEPS: tl.constexpr,
+    PREPARE_PAGES: tl.constexpr = False,
+    PageOwners=None,
+    PageTable=None,
+    PageIndices=None,
+    PageIndptr=None,
+    PAGE_OWNER_STRIDE: tl.constexpr = 0,
+    PAGE_TABLE_ROW: tl.constexpr = 0,
+    PAGE_TABLE_COL: tl.constexpr = 0,
+    PAGE_INDPTR_STRIDE: tl.constexpr = 1,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr = 8,
+):
+    page_tile = tl.program_id(0)
+    row = tl.program_id(1)
+    if page_tile == 0:
+        position = tl.load(Positions + row * POSITION_STRIDE).to(tl.int64)
+        current = position >> 3
+        tl.store(Current + row, current)
+        tl.store(Lengths + row, current + 1)
+        tl.store(TopKLengths + row, current)
+        if not NEED_SCORES:
+            _emit_all_regions(
+                current,
+                Selected + row.to(tl.int64) * (REGIONS + 1),
+                REGIONS,
+                BLOCK_REGIONS,
+            )
+        if PREPARE_PAGES:
+            col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_REGIONS)
+            region = col - (REGIONS - current)
+            selected = tl.where(region >= 0, region, -1)
+            _emit_prefill_pages(
+                selected,
+                col,
+                row,
+                PageOwners,
+                PageTable,
+                PageIndices,
+                PageIndptr,
+                REGIONS,
+                PAGE_OWNER_STRIDE,
+                PAGE_TABLE_ROW,
+                PAGE_TABLE_COL,
+                PAGE_INDPTR_STRIDE,
+                BLOCK_SIZE,
+            )
+        if NEED_SCORES and row % CHUNK_SIZE == 0:
+            query = row + tl.arange(0, CHUNK_SIZE)
+            pos = tl.load(
+                Positions + query * POSITION_STRIDE, query < ROWS, other=0
+            ).to(tl.int64)
+            lengths = ((pos >> 3) + 1).to(tl.int32)
+            _emit_indexer_schedule(
+                lengths,
+                Schedules + (row // CHUNK_SIZE) * (NUM_SMS + 1) * 2,
+                tl.minimum(ROWS - row, CHUNK_SIZE),
+                CHUNK_SIZE,
+                NUM_SMS,
+                BLOCK_SMS,
+                SEARCH_STEPS,
+            )
+    if NEED_SCORES:
+        col = page_tile * 256 + tl.arange(0, 256)
+        owner = tl.load(Owners + row * OWNER_STRIDE)
+        tl.store(
+            Table + row.to(tl.int64) * PAGES + col,
+            owner * PAGES + col,
+            col < PAGES,
+        )
+
+
+def prefill_indexer_chunk_size(regions: int) -> int:
+    """Bound FP32 logits to 128 MiB for the model's 1M-token context.
+
+    Each chunk costs a few host launches per DSA layer, so chunks are as large
+    as the bound allows.
+    """
+    padded_regions = triton.cdiv(max(1, regions), 256) * 256
+    rows = max(1, (128 << 20) // (4 * padded_regions))
+    return max(256, min(4096, 1 << (rows.bit_length() - 1)))
+
+
+def prepare_prefill_indexer(
+    owners: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    regions: int,
+    topk: int,
+    num_sms: int,
+    *,
+    paged_prefill: PagedPrefillMetadata | None = None,
+) -> list[PrefillIndexerMetadata]:
+    """Prepare bounded FI query chunks once; reuse them for every DSA layer."""
+    rows = positions.numel()
+    chunk_size = prefill_indexer_chunk_size(regions)
+    need_scores = regions > topk
+    paged_kwargs = {}
+    if paged_prefill is not None:
+        if need_scores or paged_prefill.block_size not in (16, 32, 64, 128):
+            raise ValueError("Shared pages require unscored prefill")
+        paged_kwargs = dict(
+            PREPARE_PAGES=True,
+            PageOwners=paged_prefill.owners,
+            PageTable=paged_prefill.block_table,
+            PageIndices=paged_prefill.indices,
+            PageIndptr=paged_prefill.indptr,
+            PAGE_OWNER_STRIDE=paged_prefill.owners.stride(0),
+            PAGE_TABLE_ROW=paged_prefill.block_table.stride(0),
+            PAGE_TABLE_COL=paged_prefill.block_table.stride(1),
+            PAGE_INDPTR_STRIDE=paged_prefill.indptr.stride(0),
+            BLOCK_SIZE=paged_prefill.block_size,
+        )
+    pages = triton.cdiv(regions, 128) * 4 if need_scores else 0
+    current = torch.empty(rows, device=positions.device, dtype=torch.int64)
+    lengths = torch.empty(rows, device=positions.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    topk_lengths = torch.empty_like(lengths)
+    table = torch.empty((rows, pages), device=positions.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    schedules = (
+        torch.empty(
+            (triton.cdiv(rows, chunk_size), num_sms + 1, 2),
+            device=positions.device,
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+        )
+        if need_scores
+        else None
+    )
+    selected = (
+        torch.empty((rows, regions + 1), device=positions.device, dtype=torch.int64)
+        if not need_scores
+        else None
+    )
+    if rows:
+        _prepare_prefill_indexer[(max(1, triton.cdiv(pages, 256)), rows)](
+            owners,
+            positions,
+            current,
+            lengths,
+            topk_lengths,
+            table,
+            schedules,
+            selected,
+            rows,
+            pages,
+            owners.stride(0),
+            positions.stride(0),
+            num_sms,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(num_sms + 1),
+            need_scores,
+            regions if not need_scores else 0,
+            # Sized by topk, not the prompt: every short prompt reuses one variant.
+            triton.next_power_of_2(topk + 1) if not need_scores else 1,
+            chunk_size,
+            chunk_size.bit_length(),
+            num_warps=4,
+            **paged_kwargs,
+        )
+    return [
+        PrefillIndexerMetadata(
+            current[start : start + chunk_size],
+            lengths[start : start + chunk_size],
+            topk_lengths[start : start + chunk_size],
+            table[start : start + chunk_size],
+            schedules[start // chunk_size] if schedules is not None else None,
+            selected[start : start + chunk_size] if selected is not None else None,
+        )
+        for start in range(0, rows, chunk_size)
+    ]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""RMSNorm with independent input, weight and output dtypes."""
+
+import operator
+from functools import cache
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cutlass.utils as utils
+import torch
+from cuda.bindings.driver import CUstream
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_ptr
+
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import current_stream
+
+_DTYPES = {
+    torch.float16: cutlass.Float16,
+    torch.bfloat16: cutlass.BFloat16,
+    torch.float32: Float32,
+}
+
+
+class RMSNormKernel:
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, add_residual: bool):
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.add_residual = add_residual
+        self.threads = 128 if hidden_size >= 1024 else 32
+        while hidden_size % self.threads:
+            self.threads //= 2
+        self.vec = 4
+        while hidden_size % (self.threads * self.vec):
+            self.vec //= 2
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        x_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        w_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        r_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        y_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        rows: Int32,
+        eps: Float32,
+        weight_bias: Float32,
+        stream: CUstream,
+    ):
+        layout = cute.make_layout(
+            (rows, self.hidden_size), stride=(self.hidden_size, 1)
+        )
+        x = cute.make_tensor(x_ptr, layout)
+        residual = cute.make_tensor(r_ptr, layout)
+        y = cute.make_tensor(y_ptr, layout)
+        weight = cute.make_tensor(
+            w_ptr, cute.make_layout((1, self.hidden_size), stride=(0, 1))
+        )
+        self.kernel(x, weight, residual, y, eps, weight_bias).launch(
+            grid=(rows, 1, 1), block=(self.threads, 1, 1), stream=stream
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        x: cute.Tensor,
+        weight: cute.Tensor,
+        residual: cute.Tensor,
+        y: cute.Tensor,
+        eps: Float32,
+        weight_bias: Float32,
+    ):
+        tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+        row = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+        tile = (1, self.hidden_size)
+        vectors = self.hidden_size // (self.threads * self.vec)
+        tv = cute.make_layout(
+            ((self.threads, 1), (self.vec, vectors)),
+            stride=((self.vec, 1), (1, self.threads * self.vec)),
+        )
+        x_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(),
+            x.element_type,
+            num_bits_per_copy=self.vec * x.element_type.width,
+        )
+        thread_copy = cute.make_tiled_copy(x_atom, tv, tile).get_slice(tid)
+        tx = thread_copy.partition_S(cute.local_tile(x, tile, (row, 0)))
+        tw = thread_copy.partition_S(cute.local_tile(weight, tile, (0, 0)))
+        ty = thread_copy.partition_D(cute.local_tile(y, tile, (row, 0)))
+        xf = cute.make_fragment_like(tx)
+        wf = cute.make_fragment_like(tw)
+        cute.copy(x_atom, tx, xf)
+        cute.copy(
+            cute.make_copy_atom(
+                cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(),
+                weight.element_type,
+                num_bits_per_copy=self.vec * weight.element_type.width,
+            ),
+            tw,
+            wf,
+        )
+        values = xf.load().to(Float32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.add_residual):
+            tr = thread_copy.partition_S(cute.local_tile(residual, tile, (row, 0)))
+            rf = cute.make_fragment_like(tr)
+            r_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+                cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(), Float32, num_bits_per_copy=self.vec * 32
+            )
+            cute.copy(r_atom, tr, rf)
+            values = values + rf.load()
+            rf.store(values)
+            cute.copy(r_atom, rf, tr)
+
+        partial = (values * values).reduce(
+            cute.ReductionOp.ADD, init_val=0.0, reduction_profile=0
+        )
+        total = cute.arch.warp_reduction(partial, operator.add)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.threads > 32):
+            smem = utils.SmemAllocator()
+            sums = smem.allocate_tensor(
+                Float32, cute.make_layout(self.threads // 32), byte_alignment=4
+            )
+            if tid % 32 == 0:
+                sums[tid // 32] = total
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            total = Float32(0.0)
+            for warp in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.threads // 32):
+                total = total + sums[warp]
+
+        inverse_rms = cute.math.rsqrt(total / self.hidden_size + eps, fastmath=True)
+        normalized = (values * inverse_rms) * (wf.load().to(Float32) + weight_bias)
+        yf = cute.make_fragment_like(ty)
+        yf.store(normalized.to(y.element_type))
+        cute.copy(
+            cute.make_copy_atom(
+                cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(),
+                y.element_type,
+                num_bits_per_copy=self.vec * y.element_type.width,
+            ),
+            yf,
+            ty,
+        )
+
+
+@cache
+def _compile(input_dtype, weight_dtype, output_dtype, hidden_size, add_residual):
+    def pointer(dtype):
+        return make_ptr(dtype, 16, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16)
+
+    return cute.compile(
+        RMSNormKernel(hidden_size, add_residual),
+        pointer(_DTYPES[input_dtype]),
+        pointer(_DTYPES[weight_dtype]),
+        pointer(Float32),
+        pointer(_DTYPES[output_dtype]),
+        Int32(1),
+        Float32(1e-5),
+        Float32(0.0),
+        CUstream(0),
+    )
+
+
+def supports_rms_norm(x, weight, residual=None) -> bool:
+    tensors = (x, weight) if residual is None else (x, weight, residual)
+    return (
+        x.ndim >= 2
+        and 0 < x.shape[-1] <= 16384
+        and x.shape[-1] % 32 == 0
+        and weight.ndim == 1
+        and weight.numel() == x.shape[-1]
+        and all(
+            t.is_cuda
+            and t.device == x.device
+            and t.dtype in _DTYPES
+            and t.is_contiguous()
+            and t.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+            for t in tensors
+        )
+        and (
+            residual is None
+            or (residual.shape == x.shape and residual.dtype == torch.float32)
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def rms_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    *,
+    out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    weight_bias: float = 0.0,
+    residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute in FP32 and round at the output store.
+
+    When supplied, the FP32 residual is updated in place with x + residual.
+    """
+    if not supports_rms_norm(x, weight, residual):
+        raise ValueError("Unsupported RMSNorm inputs")
+    out_dtype = out_dtype or x.dtype
+    if out_dtype not in _DTYPES:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported output dtype: {out_dtype}")
+    if out is None:
+        out = torch.empty_like(x, dtype=out_dtype)
+    elif (
+        out.shape != x.shape
+        or out.dtype != out_dtype
+        or out.device != x.device
+        or not out.is_contiguous()
+        or out.data_ptr() % 16
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Output must match shape/device/dtype and be contiguous")
+    rows = x.numel() // x.shape[-1]
+    if rows == 0:
+        return out
+    compiled = _compile(
+        x.dtype, weight.dtype, out_dtype, x.shape[-1], residual is not None
+    )
+    r_ptr = residual.data_ptr() if residual is not None else x.data_ptr()
+    compiled(
+        make_ptr(_DTYPES[x.dtype], x.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
+        make_ptr(_DTYPES[weight.dtype], weight.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
+        make_ptr(Float32, r_ptr, assumed_align=16),
+        make_ptr(_DTYPES[out_dtype], out.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
+        Int32(rows),
